output_prompt.en:
Create a single high-resolution character model sheet for the CryptoNinja character "Seori", laid out as clearly separated, labeled sections on a clean light-grey background. Keep the exact same character identity, face, colors and equipment perfectly consistent across every panel.

Base-row art style: chibi-style, 2-head-tall super-deformed proportions, thick bold black outlines, flat slightly muted coloring, hand-drawn cartoon aesthetic, CryptoNinja NFT art style.

Character: a female ninja themed on the goddess Seoritsuhime, pale blue-grey hair, red eyes, blushing cheeks, an open cheerful smile, an iron trivet crown (gotoku) with three lit white candles on her head (ushi-no-koku-mairi motif), a white kimono with a pink cherry-blossom hem pattern and a purple sash, holding a wooden mallet. Her companion Mitama — a small blue snake / floating soul-flame spirit with a white triangle forehead mark — appears beside her where noted. Saika clan.

ROW 1 — 'CHIBI TURNAROUND': chibi 2-head-tall style, 3-view turnaround (front, side, back), full body, neutral A-pose, Mitama floating beside the front view.

ROW 2 — 'FULL-BODY TURNAROUND': the SAME character redrawn in normal ~7-head-tall anime proportions, 3-view turnaround (front, side, back), full body, clean anime lineart with detailed shading.

ROW 3 — 'ALT-WORLD VARIANTS': three side-by-side full-body redesigns, each shown once chibi and once normal — (a) FANTASY: a medieval enchanted miko-priestess in flowing sacred robes, glowing candle magic, ornate gotoku crown; (b) SCI-FI: a cyberpunk shrine-maiden in neon high-tech armor, holographic candle-flames, a glowing digital snake-AI as Mitama; (c) MODERN: contemporary streetwear/techwear, a candle-crown reimagined as LED headphones, Mitama as a phone charm or hologram pet. Label each variant.

ROW 4 — 'EXPRESSION ICONS x WORLDS': a grid of chibi face/bust expression icons in small circular frames. Provide FOUR labeled rows of expressions — one row each for BASE, FANTASY, SCI-FI and MODERN versions of Seori — each row showing at least 8 expressions: neutral, happy smile, angry, sad, surprised, embarrassed/blushing, determined, laughing. Keep the face identity consistent, only the outfit/effects change per world.

ROW 5 — 'PIXEL ART / DOT-E': retro pixel-art (dot-e) sprites of the character on a transparent-look checkerboard, including: a small full-body idle sprite in front/side/back views, a 4-frame walking animation strip, and 4 tiny pixel expression face-icons. Do this in TWO resolutions side by side — a chunky 32x32 style and a more detailed 48x48 style — keeping her candle-crown, pale blue-grey hair, red eyes and purple sash readable even at low resolution.

Requirements: bold line weight and flat coloring like the reference NFT art for the chibi/normal rows; keep the three lit candles, gotoku crown, red eyes, pale blue-grey hair, cherry-blossom kimono and purple sash consistent everywhere; small clean captions per section; even lighting; no watermark. The whole sheet must read as ONE cohesive character reference usable for anime, manga, and game production (including a pixel/2D game).

SHEET LAYOUT: portrait 4:5 aspect ratio, high resolution (2K–4K). Stack the sections top-to-bottom in this exact order with a small labeled header tab on the left of each band: (header) → Row1 chibi turnaround → Row2 full-body turnaround → Row3 alt-world variants (fantasy/sci-fi/modern, each chibi+normal) → Row4 expression grid (4 labeled rows x 8 icons) → Row5 pixel art (32x32 and 48x48 side by side). CryptoNinjaのキャラ「Seori（瀬織）」のキャラクターモデルシートを高解像度で1枚に生成。薄いグレー地に区画を分け、ラベル付きで配置する。全パネルで顔・配色・装備・アイデンティティを完全に統一すること。

ベース行の画風：クリプト忍者NFT調の2頭身ちびキャラ、太い黒線、フラットでややくすんだ配色、手描きカートゥーン調。

キャラ特徴：瀬織津姫がモチーフの少女忍者。淡い青灰の髪、赤い瞳、頬に赤み、明るい笑み。頭に三本の灯った白い蝋燭を立てた五徳の冠（丑の刻参りモチーフ）。桜の裾模様の白い着物と紫の帯。木槌を持つ。相棒ミタマ（白い三角の額印を持つ小さな青い蛇／鬼火の精霊）は指定箇所で傍らに描く。雑賀クラン。

1行目『ちび三面図』…2頭身ちびの正面・側面・背面ターンアラウンド、全身、Aポーズ。正面の傍らにミタマを浮かべる。

2行目『通常三面図』…同キャラを7頭身のアニメ体型で描き直した正面・側面・背面、全身、丁寧な陰影のクリーンなアニメ線画。

3行目『世界観バリエ』…全身の描き直しを3種、各々ちび版と通常版の両方で並べる。(a)ファンタジー：中世の神聖な巫女装束、蝋燭の魔法の発光、装飾的な五徳冠。(b)SF：ネオンのハイテク装甲のサイバーパンク巫女、ホログラムの蝋燭火、デジタルの蛇AIとしてのミタマ。(c)現代パロ：ストリート／テックウェア、蝋燭冠をLEDヘッドフォンに翻案、ミタマはスマホのチャームまたはホログラムのペット。各ラベル付き。

4行目『表情アイコン×世界観』…ちびの顔／バストアップ表情アイコンを円形フレームでグリッド配置。ラベル付きで4行——ベース／ファンタジー／SF／現代パロの各バージョンで1行ずつ——各行に最低8表情（通常・笑・怒・哀・驚・照れ・決意・大笑い）。顔のアイデンティティは統一し、世界観ごとに衣装／エフェクトのみ変える。

5行目『ドット絵（ピクセルアート）』…透過風のチェッカー地にレトロなドット絵スプライト。全身の待機スプライト（正面・側面・背面）、4フレームの歩行アニメ帯、小さなピクセル表情アイコン4種を含む。解像度は2種を並べる——ゴツめの32x32スタイルと、より細密な48x48スタイル。低解像度でも蝋燭冠・淡い青灰の髪・赤い瞳・紫帯が判別できるようにする。
